subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Beginning Knowledge: Disasters and what we should do
source.subtopic: Types of disaster: floods, fire; other phenomena: lightning, earthquakes, storms and strong winds

show.line: Floods, fires, storms and lightning can be dangerous. We stay calm and safe.

rounds.prompt: A fire! What do you do?
rounds.praise: Get out and call for help!

rounds.prompt: In a flood, go to higher...?

rounds.story: Strong winds blow roofs off homes. People need help. What happened?

hints: Never shelter under a tree in lightning.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I'll stand under a tall tree!

parent_line: Can name disasters and what to do in them.
